description: This file defines the interface for a WLAN monitor hardware abstraction layer class (`mon_wlan_hal_nl80211`) within the 'bwl' namespace, including function declarations for updating stats, handling events, and managing WLAN scan operations. It includes class inheritance and mentions specific WLAN functionalities.

classes.name: mon_wlan_hal_nl80211
classes.description: Hardware abstraction layer class for WLAN Monitor, extending base_wlan_hal_nl80211 and mon_wlan_hal, providing WLAN monitor functionalities.
